positions.title: Manager, Technical Packaging
positions.description: Managed projects from packaging conception to industrialization.  Led efforts on continuous improvement and sustainability initiatives for the liquid makeup category.  Supported and driven solutions to packaging consumer complaints, non-conformities, and troubleshoot technical issues across the entire supply chain.

positions.title: Trauma and Extremities | Senior Project Engineer, R&D-Packaging
positions.description:
Managed the packaging development of newly developed devices for shoulder arthroplasty. Provided subject matter expertise for packaging remediation, sustaining efforts, and regulatory submissions.
• Successfully implemented sterile and non-sterile packaging systems for five new product development projects.
• Coordinated discussions across multiple divisions about packaging sustaining issues and developed solutions to improve packaging designs and methods
• Facilitated efforts for generating technical documentation and execution of V&V tests for multiple projects.
Technical documentation included: Packaging Specifications, Packaging V&V Test Protocols and Reports
V&V Tests included: Packaging Performance Test, Shelf Life testing (Aged), and Usability Evaluation.
• Provided support to bring packaging systems to meet ISO standards and EU-MDR regulation requirements.

positions.title: Orthobiologics | Packaging Engineer, R&D
positions.description:
Worked on interdisciplinary design teams and with packaging component suppliers to develop sterile packaging solutions. Maintained component specifications for primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging.
• Effectively improved the packaging designs for four products that exhibited performance issues with their previous packaging systems.
• Employed a packaging inventory system to outline packaging information for all existing Orthobiologics products. The inventory system was used to evaluate each packaging configuration to determine potential design improvements.
• Integrated the Stryker Orthobiologics packaging procedures with the Stryker Spine packaging procedures to ensure continuity between both divisions’ packaging design and testing requirements.
• Maintained label designs, labeling database and supporting documentation for existing Orthobiologics products.

positions.title: Joint Replacement | Operation Engineer, Packaging Cell
positions.description:
Conducted validation and DOEs for new equipment, materials, and processes in clean rooms. Investigated operational effectiveness and initiated continuous process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness
• Reduced the X3SC contents-to-box process time by 25% and workspace by 30% using lean lighthouse methods.
• Implemented new equipment to decrease the assembly time for the Acetabular products and to increase the ergonomics for process operators.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description: Designed lighting and power system layouts for hospitals and medical centers. Assured quality of CAD drawings prior to project submissions.

positions.title: Associate Intern
positions.description:
•	Verified  prototypes were the most efficient and effective designs
•	Validated test methods to assure adherence to FDA/ISO standards 
•	Assisted in mechanical testing and created technical reports 
•	Generated statistical summaries of results from product tests
•	Created basic 3D models and drawings
